prompt: Identify the part with the grammatical error (or 'No error').
sentence: The young sub-inspector was accompanied with (A) / a heavily armed police contingent to raid (B) / the suspected illegal warehouses near the port. (C) / No Error (D)
options: The young sub-inspector was accompanied with
a heavily armed police contingent to raid
the suspected illegal warehouses near the port.
explanation: When a person is escorted by another person or group, the passive takes 'accompanied by'; 'accompanied with' is used for accompanying things, so write 'was accompanied by a heavily armed police contingent'.
